fullDescription: An academic, institutional design system inspired by vintage museum archives and modern digital repositories. It features a sophisticated palette of cream, deep botanical green, and accent gold, combined with high-contrast editorial typography. Key elements include a noise-textured overlay, 'plaque' corner borders, and grayscale-to-color transitions. This style is ideal for research archives, luxury educational platforms, museum collections, and high-end editorial portfolios requiring a sense of legacy, discovery, and precision.
prompt:
## Resumo
A refined, scholarly UI with a focus on archival aesthetics, leveraging 'Playfair Display' for editorial emphasis and 'Outfit' for modern utility. The layout uses institutional grids, semantic search interfaces, and subtle micro-animations to create a 'living' digital archive.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with an 'Institutional Archive' aesthetic. 
- **Color Palette**: Background: #fefdef (Cream); Secondary Surface: #eeedd9 (Tan); Primary Action: #00604a (Forest Green); Accent: #bd264a (Cranberry Red); Metallic: #d4af37 (Gold); Text: #2c2c2c (Charcoal).
- **Typography**: Headers in 'Playfair Display', Serif. Body and UI labels in 'Outfit', Sans-Serif. Use uppercase with tracking (0.2em - 0.3em) for small labels and category tags.
- **Texture**: Apply a fixed noise overlay using a fractal noise SVG at 0.08 opacity to create a paper-like feel.
- **Borders & Corners**: Use 1px borders in #00604a at 15% opacity. Implement 'Plaque Corners': 16x16px L-shaped borders in #d4af37 (1.5px thickness) positioned at the absolute corners of card containers.
- **Animations**: Implement a 'float' animation (6s ease-in-out infinite, 15px travel) for decorative assets. Use a stagger-reveal on page load (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 20px to 0).
- **Interactive Elements**: Grayscale images that transition to full color and scale 1.1x on hover. Buttons use sharp corners (rounded-sm, 2px radius).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Sticky header (bg: #fefdef, border-b: 1px #00604a/10). Left: Square logo block (#00604a) with serif initial. Center: Uppercase nav links in 12px 'Outfit' with 0.1s color transition. Right: Discovery/Exhibition toggle switch (pill-shaped, 10% charcoal bg, green indicator) and a sharp 'Sign In' button.

### Hero Section
Split layout. Left: Large typography block. Editorial label in uppercase gold. Headline in 8xl 'Playfair Display' using a mix of regular and italic (Red accent). Subheadline in 2xl light-weight sans-serif. Right: Floating decorative artifact inside a 60s slow-spinning orbital ring (1px gold border).

### Search & Filter Dashboard
Tan surface (#eeedd9) container with plaque corners. Title: 'Semantic Search Interface' in tiny uppercase tracking. Input: 4xl 'Playfair Display' bottom-border only. Grid: 4-column filter rows (Era, Category, Materiality, Curator) with custom select dropdowns. Bottom: Checkbox filters and a 'Detailed Parameters' toggle with chevron icon.

### Dark Feature Section
Deep Green (#002f24) background. Centered serif heading with gold divider. Grid of 4 cards: transparent background with white/10 border. Icons in #d4af37. Description text in light-weight Outfit with 70% opacity. Hover state: bg-white/10 and icon scale 1.1x.

### Research Insights Grid
3-column article layout. Top: Image container with plaque corners and grayscale-to-color hover. Middle: Category/Date in gold uppercase. Title: 2xl serif. Footer: Author and artifact count separated by a thin green border. Hover effect: Title changes to #bd264a and box-shadow increases.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Plaque Corners — Traditional archive-style corner accents.
Create 4 absolute-positioned divs for container corners. Each 16px wide/high. Use 'border-t border-l' for top-left, 'border-t border-r' for top-right, etc. Color: #d4af37. Thickness: 1.5px. Offset by 16px from the container edge.

### Institutional Statistics — High-impact numerical data displays.
Centered container. Label: tiny green uppercase. Number: 5xl 'Playfair Display' in #bd264a. Underline: 12px wide #d4af37 bar that expands to 20px on parent hover.

style.description: The style blends traditional museum signage with a clean, high-tech interface. It uses a cream-colored background (#fefdef) to mimic aged paper, paired with a subtle SVG fractal noise overlay (8% opacity) for texture. Typography uses 'Playfair Display' for headlines (including italics for emphasis) and 'Outfit' for functional text. Accent colors include Primary Green (#00604a), Secondary Red (#bd264a), and Accent Gold (#d4af37). Layouts are defined by thin 1px borders, generous whitespace, and 'plaque-corner' L-shapes.
